changelog:
### Discord Companion 2.8.2 — Real Names Everywhere

- **Servers resolve to their real names.** Discord's `CLIENT_STATE_V2` payload nests guild fields inside `properties` (and can leave the old top-level keys as `null`). The daemon now reads both shapes, including JSON-encoded `properties`, so "Server" is gone and every guild — including Personal Space — shows its actual name.
- **DMs resolve to people.** A one-to-one DM is labelled from its recipient, not from a stored placeholder. Existing rows that still say "Direct Message" / "Group DM" are recomputed and heal on read, and unresolved `recipient_ids` are backfilled from the local user directory.
- **Voice history names participants.** The timeline stores the display name with each session and falls back to the local user directory, so people who are not on your friend list no longer appear as "Someone".
- **Fresh catalog on every launch.** The daemon clears the persisted gateway resume state once per process start, forcing a full IDENTIFY/READY instead of resuming an old session that carries stale catalog rows.
- **New DMs and messages update the catalog immediately.** A DM created after launch is stored as soon as Discord announces the channel, and message authors keep the local user directory fresh.
- **Local-only, as always.** No new hosts, no telemetry, no AI endpoints. The token stays in the daemon; the catalog, inbox and session history stay in SQLite.
- **Also in this release:** the universal macOS `.dmg` is rebuilt on the same version, and the Windows setup, portable zip, shell, daemon and macOS image are all minisign-signed with the pinned key.

broadcast.title: Discord Companion v2.8.2 is Live!
broadcast.message: Real names everywhere: servers, DMs and voice history resolve from Discord's live catalog, old placeholder rows heal on read, and each launch re-seeds from a fresh READY. Everything stays local.
